admission.justification: The transport accepts canonical task-reference forms; handing it a physical projection path produces400 and silently removes reports from the page.

applicability: A task page listing its recorded role reports through the reports endpoint.
conditions: The request names the document path inside the task root, not its projected physical file path.
Recorded-start listing stays bounded and read-only.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/page-look.test.tsx: 'asks for them by the path inside the task root when the document carries a file path' (fails with the repair taken out: notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f5/checks/reports-test-without-fix.log); notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f5/sandbox/reports-probe.json (the sandbox's server answers with the one recorded report)

statement: The task page asks for a task's reports with the document's path inside the task root, because the server accepts the document only as that path or as /tasks/<repo>/<path> and answers 400 for the file path a projected document carries.
